predictions.base_table: theta_A07 = ViennaRNA's shipped Andronescu 2007 set (params_load_RNA_Andronescu2007, read through params_save) written on the Turner 2004 template at the 12,849 shared keys (shards/a07.par, sha256 in the build record); the non-shared keys are special hairpins, unused at special_hp 0. Its reproduction of the shipped set is the build's B1-B9
predictions.conservative_choices_claude: where the plan left a detail open: (1) every theta0 of the fold and of E1 is theta_A07, including the carry rows and the Boltzmann probe (the generating row whose energy A07 changes most against Turner 2004); (2) the Ninio linearisation is asserted exact for every table loaded; (3) the point-level planted controls (S3, S4 at a point) leave the closest stale table loaded, the A07 base, not Turner 2004 (B8 and the sampler's S4 use Turner 2004's factors, the only other table loaded at that stage); (4) the run phases require the committed artifact, so the lead commits after smoke and after the fold; (5) the contrast directions are re-checked orthogonal to both null bases and supported in the four tables at their own norms; (6) the build must run on a tree clean outside runs/, and every later phase requires the code (this script's static import closure over scripts/ and thermo/) to be the build's, the run phases also the smoke's; (7) every point carries the Type B fold's written integer perturbation, keeping its half-integer tie-breaks (points_written_claude), and the build re-asserts the equality; (8) the driver terminates the other workers on the first failure; a RUNNING status left by a killed driver is reset by hand only

definitions.changed: the MFE structure under the point table differs from A07's baseline MFE
definitions.genuine: for a sequence whose MFE changed (s0 -> s1): c1 . (theta_A07 + delta) + off1 <= c0 . (theta_A07 + delta) + off0 + EXACT_TIE (exact unrounded energies; turner_typeb.EXACT_TIE = 1e-9 dcal is float round-off, not a tolerance); rounding-caused otherwise
definitions.information: I(v) = sum_x Var_{s~P_A07(.|x)}[c(s).v] / kT^2 at theta_A07, kT from the compound's own Boltzmann factors; K = 2,000 pbacktrack samples per sequence (md.uniq_ML = 1), ViennaRNA's sampler seeded RNA.init_rand(20261014 + sequence index); per-sequence sample variance ddof 1
definitions.paired_dF1_claude: mean over sequences of F1(point MFE, reference) - F1(A07 baseline MFE, reference), both rounded to 6 places as the fold stores them, so an unchanged MFE contributes exactly 0
definitions.tie_split: dE0 = c1 . theta_A07 + off1 - e0 >= 0 (must hold; s0 is A07's MFE): a tie flip iff dE0 = 0, a real reordering iff dE0 > 0

predictions.execution: 6 niced workers per run (nice 10), sharded by sequence index mod 6; OMP/OPENBLAS/MKL = 1, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=''; drivers under setsid; about 20 min for the fold (E3's measured MFE rate) and 10-15 min for the sampler (E1's)
predictions.exploratory_claude: the fold: genuine changed-MFE fraction per point minus the Turner fold's at the same direction and norm (the mirrored point against point 191), on the same sequences from the fold's sha-checked shards, sequence bootstrap (2000 draws, rng SeedSequence([20261012, 65])); E1: I per direction against E1's registered sha-checked shards on the same sequences; ratio of ratios (A07 over Turner 2004) with a paired sequence bootstrap (2000 draws, rng SeedSequence([20261012, 63]))
predictions.exploratory_user: paired-by-direction differences, A07 minus Turner base, and the ratio of the two information ratios
predictions.must_hold: fold baseline: c0 . theta_A07 + off0 = e0 and c(ref) . theta_A07 + off_ref = eval(ref) on every sequence; every sequence's f1_ref and A07 reference energy reproduce E3's sha-checked full:Andronescu2007 shards (eref0 + dref_dcal), joined by name. Per point: params_match (spot check; the carry rows bind where it cannot see the table, recorded per point as params_match_can_see), 5 carry rows, the Boltzmann carry; per sequence the reference-energy identity, the MFE-energy identity and dE0 >= 0. Fisher: params_match and the generic Boltzmann check on the first compound (including the sampling compound's own exp_params: TerminalAU and ML_cc to 1e-6 dcal); C . N_int = 0 in integers on every sample; reconstruction c . theta_A07 + o = eval_structure on the first sample of every 4th sequence per shard. Any failure stops the run; nothing is repaired
predictions.planted_controls: B7 one int22 entry +1 dcal fails B5 on exactly its rows; B8 stale Boltzmann factors fail the generic check (constrained pf and exp_params); B4 params_match non-empty against Turner 2004; S3 skip-load caught at the point (params_match or a carry row, not a baseline guard); S4 stale Boltzmann caught at a point (Boltzmann carry) and in the sampler (generic check, both its exp_params and its constrained-pf parts)
predictions.points: 33 written tables at the fold's directions: the fold's 8 random null directions at 4 and 16 kcal/mol (its delta_dcal rows 10i+5, 10i+7); the fold's 8 contrast directions at the same norms (rows 115+10j, 117+10j; reported without prediction); the mirrored component delta = -delta_dcal[191] = P_nt(theta_T04 - theta_A07), 21.03 kcal/mol. The directions stay null at A07 because A and N_nt do not depend on theta
predictions.points_written_claude: each written table carries the fold's written integer perturbation, theta_r = theta_A07 + (theta_r - theta_T04 at the fold's row), negated for the mirrored point (row 191); every entry is a nearest-integer rounding of theta_A07 + delta (|theta_r - theta_A07 - delta| <= 0.5 + 1e-9 dcal, asserted). It equals rint(theta_A07 + delta) except at half-integer ties, where np.rint (half to even) at the A07 base could break the tie the other way than the fold did; the fold's tie-break is kept and every such entry is recorded in the build, so the written perturbations, written errors and leaks are exactly the fold's (negated for the mirror)
predictions.question_user: is the Type B effect specific to Turner 2004? Repeat it with Andronescu 2007 as theta0
predictions.registered: 2026-10-12, after the build (theta_A07 written on the Turner 2004 template and verified, B1-B9; the 33 points fixed in shards/points_a07.npz) and before any smoke, fold or sampling; written before any run
predictions.registered_test_information_claude: the ratio is mean I over the 8 contrast directions over mean I over the 8 random null directions (typeb_fisher.directions); the CI is the percentile interval of the 2000 sequence-bootstrap draws; rng default_rng(SeedSequence([20261012, 61]))
predictions.registered_test_information_user: the contrast/null information ratio at A07 (E1's statistic and directions) has a 95% CI lower bound > 1 (2000-draw sequence bootstrap)
predictions.registered_test_mirrored_claude: _boot_mean as the fold uses it: percentile 95% CI, 1000 draws over the 11,970 sequences; rng default_rng(SeedSequence([20261012, 60, 0]))
predictions.registered_test_mirrored_user: the mirrored component's genuine changed-MFE fraction has a 95% CI that excludes 0 (turner_typeb._boot_mean)
predictions.reported_without_prediction_claude: per-point CIs by _boot_mean (1000 draws, rng SeedSequence([20261012, 64, p, k])); rounding share = (changed - genuine) / changed; leak = c(ref) . (theta_r - theta_A07) as median, 95th percentile and max (kcal/mol, pair-bearing references); the Turner fold's values are its registered experiment_2.points; null minus contrast genuine fraction at 4 and 16 by the fold's amendment-1 bootstrap (2000 draws, one sequence resample shared by both arms, each arm's 8 directions resampled; rng SeedSequence([20261012, 62])); I with CIs from the registered test's draws and Cramer-Rao SEs 1/sqrt(I)
predictions.reported_without_prediction_user: per point: changed (all), genuine and real-reordering fractions, dF1 and rounding share; null means at 4 and 16 kcal/mol beside the Turner fold's; the contrast directions at the same norms; per-direction I at A07, with intrinsic exactly 0 by the integer must-hold
predictions.smoke: S1 Turner-mode fold reproduces the fold shards at points 5, 7, 191 on 60 sequences, and every changed sequence's dE0 >= the fold's baseline gap (dE0 >= 100 dcal where the gap is above 100); S2 Turner-mode sampler reproduces the gradient run's Ix rows bit for bit (sequences 0, 8, 16, 24); S3, S4 planted controls; S5 mini run. Must pass before run-fold
predictions.table2_a07_row_claude: the plan's Table 2 has null/contrast columns at 1 and 16 kcal/mol and a 'component changed % minus control' column; its A2 section (B9) and docs/PLAN.md fix A2's points at 4 and 16 kcal/mol with no +-1 dcal control, and A2 follows them. The A07 MFE row therefore reports: component = the mirrored point's genuine changed-MFE fraction with the registered test's CI (for MFE the exact genuine/rounding split takes the place of A1's +-1 dcal control, which A1 needs because MEA and centroid have no exact split), its rounding share beside it; dF1 = the mirrored point's paired dF1; null/contrast at 16 kcal/mol = A2's 16 kcal/mol values; the 1 kcal/mol cells are empty (not measured at A07; not replaced by the 4 kcal/mol values, which go to the supplement)
